text:
mia-cs: Heads up — prepping Nimbus QBR. Token run-rate spiked this week, want to surface risks and quick mitigations. Who can pull a 30-day burn + 7d accel? :wave:
sam-finance: I pulled preliminary numbers — 30d avg 1.2B tokens, last 7d avg 2.6B. Main driver: embeddings-heavy batch jobs from their staging integration.
devon-ops: @sam-finance can you paste the per-route breakdown? if it's mostly /embed we should enable soft-throttle and a budget alert rule.
sam-finance: Route split: /embed 78%, /generate 15%, /analysis 7%. Quick snapshot: ``30d: 1.2B tokens (~$18k), 7d: 2.6B (~$39k)``. Forecasting runway at current pace -> ~2 weeks of freemium credits.
jordan-customer: FYI we've flagged onboarding as at-risk — customer ramped tests and left retries enabled. CS touched base yesterday; they're expecting a spike this week as data migrations finish. Renewal conversation scheduled in 3 weeks.
mia-cs: Ok immediate asks: (1) reduce cost blast risk, (2) make QBR number story + remediation, (3) enable alerts and ops play. Proposed quick actions below.
devon-ops: Proposed actions: 1) add route-level budget alert at 50% of monthly expected spend for /embed (alert -> #customer-success + #eng-runtime). 2) Apply transient soft-throttle for any single API key > 10 req/s for /embed for next 72h. 3) Add caching layer for repeat embedding vectors where request hash matches.
sam-finance: I'll create the spend forecast slide: baseline, spike scenario, mitigation impact. Need a conservative estimate for post-mitigation burn — assume 60% reduction on embed-heavy jobs -> 7d projected tokens -> 1.0B.
jordan-customer: Can CS reach out to the customer's SRE and ask them to disable concurrent retries and stagger migration windows? that'll help a lot. I'll draft a short email.
mia-cs: Please do. Also we should surface an ask in the QBR: offer a one-time Dedicated trial for their migration week to stabilize latency + cost predictability. Mention SLA + burst bucket.
devon-ops: I'll provision the alert and throttle tonight; leaving a small grace window for legitimate traffic. Also adding a temporary billing tag so we can attribute the spike to the migration.
onboarding-bot: Automation: budget_alert created -> rule_id=ba-1772-nimbus-01, notify=#customer-success,#eng-runtime.
sam-finance: Draft QBR numbers for review: Baseline monthly spend $36k, Spike scenario $78k, After mitigation $28k. I'll attach a simple sensitivity table.
mia-cs: Nice. Action owners: sam-finance -> QBR numbers + slide by EOD, devon-ops -> alerts + throttle deployed by tonight, jordan-customer -> outreach email draft in 2 hours, mia-cs -> runbook + renewal risk note. We'll reconvene tomorrow at 10am PT for a 15m check. :thumbsup:
jordan-customer: Draft sent to the customer SRE, cc'd CS. waiting on response.
devon-ops: Alerts live and throttle rule applied. Monitoring dashboard pinned to #customer-success.
mia-cs: Thanks team — capture these as blockers/asks in the QBR doc and include remediation timeline. If the customer accepts Dedicated trial, finance to sketch provisional pricing for a 4-week window.
sam-finance: Added provisional pricing row in the doc. Link: https://redwood.internal/qbrs/nimbus-2026 (internal).
mia-cs: Great. Closing the thread for now — will post the 10am agenda in the morning. :coffee:
